raw_entities.name: Customer Identification
raw_entities.description: Customer Identification policy establishing Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements for customer onboarding and ongoing compliance. This policy governs the identity verification process as a core compliance obligation.

raw_entities.name: Privacy and Data Protection
raw_entities.description: Privacy and Data Protection policy addressing GDPR compliance requirements. This policy establishes the bank's framework for handling personal data and ensuring regulatory compliance with data protection legislation.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Handling Policy
raw_entities.description: Formal policy governing the bank's complaint handling procedures and customer complaint resolution processes. This policy establishes the framework for managing and resolving customer complaints in compliance with regulatory requirements.
